sloka: स तां विधूमानलसन्निकाशां वित्रासिनीं वानरवाहिनीनाम् ।चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसाज्वलन्तीं सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः ।। ६.५९.१०८ ।।।।
transliteration: sa tāṁ vidhūmānalasannikāśāṁ vitrāsinīṁ vānaravāhinīnām ।cikṣepa śaktiṁ tarasājvalantīṁ saumitraye rākṣasarāṣṭranāthaḥ ।। 6.59.108 ।।।।

translations.english: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.
